title: KiCAD MCP Server Configuration
description: General configuration options for the KiCAD MCP Server

clientMode.description: Mode of operation for the server

options.mcp: Standard Model Context Protocol mode for AI assistants like Claude
options.api: REST API mode for HTTP-based integrations
options.bridge: Bridge mode for connecting to external KiCAD instances

logDir.description: Directory for log files. If empty, uses default ~/.kicad-mcp/logs

autoLaunchUI.description: Automatically launch KiCAD UI when needed

pythonPath.description: Path to KiCAD Python modules. Auto-detected if not specified

kicadPath.description: Path to KiCAD installation directory. Auto-detected if not specified

allowedProjectPaths.description: List of allowed base directories for project operations. Empty array allows all paths

restrictFileOperations.description: Restrict file operations to project directories only

enableResources.description: Enable MCP resources capability for real-time project state access

enablePrompts.description: Enable MCP prompts capability for guided workflows

maxConcurrentOperations.description: Maximum number of concurrent KiCAD operations

port.description: Port for API/bridge mode (only used when clientMode is 'api' or 'bridge')
